scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm typecheck:scripts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm -r test && pnpm --filter @bolerish/edge-docs test:browser && pnpm verify:packages
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm build && pnpm verify:packages && npx --yes wrangler@4.157.0 pages deploy --cwd docs --branch main
scripts.test:react-compat: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @bolerish/edge-docs exec node scripts/verify-react-compatibility.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @bolerish/edge-core --filter @bolerish/edge-styles test && pnpm --filter @bolerish/edge test:unit
